Subject: Request for a Quieter Table

Dear [Restaurant Name] Team,

I’m writing to ask about a reservation for a small book-club gathering on [date] at approximately [time]. We expect [number] guests and would be grateful, if possible, for a table in a quieter area of the restaurant—perhaps away from the bar, entrance, kitchen, or larger parties.

Our group will be enjoying dinner while discussing our current book, so a setting where everyone can hear one another comfortably would mean a great deal. We completely understand that seating depends on availability, other reservations, and the natural energy of the evening, and we appreciate that a quiet table cannot be guaranteed.

Thank you for considering our request. We look forward to visiting.

Warmly,  
[Your Name]
